label: gate2 rehearsal on validation (not a verdict)
banner: **REHEARSAL on VALIDATION data. This is not the Gate 2 verdict.** It checks the pipeline against the frozen validation numbers.

original.note: B is the largest confirmation saving among all validation-qualified baselines, including any that exceed 1 pp loss on confirmation; it is re-determined inside every resample.

amendment.task_aware_note: B uses benchmark identity: a task-aware control, not a deployable policy. B was chosen on validation among 1,024 vectors, so its validation numbers were optimistic.
amendment.interpretation_guard: The original verdict is reported separately above. B outperforming P or Q does not alter it.
